paite: Nipi la a vuk bang leh pawltak lai a vuah bang in, zahtakhuaina mihai a ding in akilawm kei hi.
english: Like snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honor is not fitting for a fool.

paite: Kawlgit avakvaih bang in, phialphiah alen lai bang in, huchi mah bang in hamsia bulbal nei lou atangtung kei hi.
english: Like a fluttering sparrow, like a darting swallow, so the undeserved curse doesn’t come to rest.

paite: Zepna sakol a ding, kamkaihna sabiltung a ding, huan chiang mihaite nungzang a ding ahi.
english: A whip is for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the back of fools!

paite: Mihai ahaina dungzui in dawng ke'n, huchi lou in zaw nang leng amah na bang kha ding.
english: Don’t answer a fool according to his folly, lest you also be like him.

paite: Mihai ahaina bang in dawng in, ama kideihna ah apilsak kha ding hi.
english: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own eyes.

paite: Kuapeuh mihai khut a thukhak in amah khete atankhia a, siatna ding adawn hi.
english: One who sends a message by the hand of a fool is cutting off feet and drinking violence.

paite: Khebai khete a kikhai nelnel; huai bangmah in mihaite kam sung a gentehna ahi.
english: Like the legs of the lame that hang loose, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

paite: Mihai kiang a zahna piak zaw suanglotna khau a suang gakkhawm bang ahi.
english: As one who binds a stone in a sling, so is he who gives honor to a fool.

paite: Zukham hat khut a loulingnei bang in, huai bangmah in mihaite kam sung a gentehna ahi.
english: Like a thorn bush that goes into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

paite: Mihai leh mivialvak guaimi, thalkap siam midang liamsak zel mi bang ahi.
english: As an archer who wounds all, so is he who hires a fool or he who hires those who pass by.

paite: Ui ama luak lam a kik nawn bang in, huai bangmah in ahaina sunzom mihai ahi.
english: As a dog that returns to his vomit, so is a fool who repeats his folly.

paite: Ama kideihna a pil mi na mu hia? Amah a pan sang in mihai a kipan lametna a-om zaw hi.
english: Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

paite: Thadah in, "Lampi ah humpinelkai a-om; kongzing ah humpinelkai a- om," achi hi.
english: The sluggard says, “There is a lion in the road! A fierce lion roams the streets!”

paite: Kongkhak a kopza ah akihei zel bang in, alupna tung ah thadahna a-om hi.
english: As the door turns on its hinges, so does the sluggard on his bed.

paite: Thadah in kuang sung ah akhut athun a; akam atun ngap nawn kei hi.
english: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish. He is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth.

paite: Thadah ama kideihna ah asan pe thei ding mi sagih sang in pil akisa zaw hi.
english: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer with discretion.

paite: Kuapeuh paisuak a, amah a hilou kinakna a kihihbuai, ui abil a man bang ahi.
english: Like one who grabs a dog’s ears is one who passes by and meddles in a quarrel not his own.

paite: Mihai in mei-ekte, thal leh sihna viallot bang in;
english: Like a madman who shoots torches, arrows, and death,

paite: mi invengte khem a, chiamnui ka hi kei a hia? chi toh akibang hi.
english: is the man who deceives his neighbor and says, “Am I not joking?”

paite: Sing taksap ziak in mei amit a; huan huauhatmi omlouhna ah, kinakna abei hi.
english: For lack of wood a fire goes out. Without gossip, a quarrel dies down.

paite: Suangkuangtheite meisumsa a ding bang in leh sing mei a ding bang in; kinak hatmi kilanna uangsak ahi.
english: As coals are to hot embers, and wood to fire, so is a contentious man to kindling strife.

paite: Huauhatmi thute an limtak bang ahi, huan gilpi sungnungpen ah atumsuk hi.
english: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, they go down into the innermost parts.

paite: Leibel limlang tui a luan bang in, lungtang gilou muk azol in anal hi!
english: Like silver dross on an earthen vessel are the lips of a fervent one with an evil heart.

paite: Mihuauhat in amuk in athehdalh a, alungtang in khemna apai.
english: A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors evil in his heart.

paite: Kilawmna thu agen chiang in, amah um ke'n; alungtang ah lah kihhuai sagih a-om ngal a.
english: When his speech is charming, don’t believe him, for there are seven abominations in his heart.

paite: Ahuatna khemna in kituam mahleh, khawmpite ma ah tangpi muh in agitlouhna etsak ahi ding hi.
english: His malice may be concealed by deception, but his wickedness will be exposed in the assembly.

paite: Kuapeuh khuk tou huai ah ake ding; huan kuapeuh suang khuk, amah tung ah hong kileh ding hi.
english: Whoever digs a pit shall fall into it. Whoever rolls a stone, it will come back on him.

paite: Lei zuauthei in ahihliamsate amudah a, maitangphat hat kam in siatna abawl hi.
english: A lying tongue hates those it hurts; and a flattering mouth works ruin.
